title: Blanche Downplays Questions Over Nvidia as Investigators Examine Company’s Customers
description: Justice Department investigators have gathered evidence of Nvidia’s high-powered computer chips being illegally diverted by other firms to China, according to people familiar with the inquiries.
author: Devlin Barrett and Ana Swanson

title: Jensen Huang Apologizes to Nvidia Employees, Says He Is in Therapy
description: A day after returning to his company, Mr. Huang acknowledged that he had violated Nvidia’s code of conduct and “made some terrible mistakes.”
author: Tripp Mickle and Kalley Huang

title: Trump’s Own Stock Portfolio Likely Benefits From Nvidia’s Rise
description: It’s not possible to determine the size of the president’s stake in the chip maker because there is a lag between when trades occur and when they are disclosed.
author: Ben Protess

title: OpenAI Engineer Secretly Recorded Dozens of Meetings, Prosecutors Say
description: Abdulrahman Alfozan, who has been jailed since October, will be freed on a $1 million bond. Prosecutors say he recorded dozens of meetings.
author: Emmy Martin

title: What Nvidia’s Interim CEO, Colette Kress, Said to Employees After Jensen Huang’s Resignation
description: At an all-hands meeting with employees, Colette Kress sought to put the indiscretions of Nvidia’s co-founder, Jensen Huang, behind them.
author: Tripp Mickle

title: From Chinese Factory Town to the Nvidia Scandal: The Rise of Alice Huang
description: The woman whose role has become a focus of the Nvidia spying saga grew up in a small town built around a weapons factory. Her jump to finance and the tech world paralleled China’s own.
author: Paul Mozur, Keith Bradsher, Mara Hvistendahl, Michael Forsythe and Ana Swanson

title: With Jensen Huang’s Return as C.E.O., Trump Effectively Overrode Nvidia’s Board
description: Nvidia’s board said Mr. Huang would not be back. But President Trump, who pushed for Mr. Huang’s reinstatement, effectively overrode the board, governance experts said.
author: Kalley Huang, Jordyn Holman, Lauren Hirsch and Ryan Mac

title: Why Trump Put Jensen Huang Back in Charge at Nvidia
description: In a shocking turn, the chip-making giant reinstated its chief executive. We unpack how it happened — and what it means.
author: Max Read, Sawyer Roque, Vjeran Pavic, Alyssa Moxley, Chris Wood, Katie McMurran, Dan Powell, Elisheba Ittoop, Marion Lozano, Sophia Lanman and Rowan Niemisto

title: Trump’s Extraordinary Nvidia Intervention Sidelines National Security Concerns
description: President Trump’s move to put Jensen Huang back at the helm of Nvidia caps his indifference to the warnings of his own intelligence agencies.
author: Peter Baker

title: Trump Is Said to Have Pushed to Reinstate Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
description: The president set in motion a weekend of maneuvering, led by Vice President JD Vance, to help Jensen Huang get his old job back.
author: Maggie Haberman, Jonathan Swan and Julian E. Barnes

title: Republicans Break With Trump Over Jensen Huang’s Reinstatement at Nvidia
description: It was a rare instance of the G.O.P. pushing back on the president and threatening to use its oversight and legislative power to challenge his administration’s approach.
author: Robert Jimison

title: Have You Worked With Nvidia? We Want to Hear From You.
description: Fill out the form below and a reporter will be in touch.
author: The New York Times

title: Jensen Huang’s Return as Nvidia CEO Feels Like Déjà Vu in Silicon Valley
description: The rise, fall and return of founders of Silicon Valley tech companies is a well-worn tale.
author: Cade Metz

title: Why Nostalgia for Tamagotchis, the Virtual Pets, Won’t Die
description: Millennials are answering the beeping call of the pocket-size game that caused a sensation 30 years ago. But analog-craving Gen Z-ers are, too.
author: Sarah Bahr

title: SpaceX Sued By Oregon and Virginia Over A.I.-Generated Sexualized Images
description: The states accused Elon Musk’s company of violating consumer protection laws with its Grok Imagine artificial intelligence tool, which created the images.
author: Kate Conger and Grace Kay

title: Looking for the Formula to Stop an Apocalypse
description: Mike Winer and his colleagues are trying to build a mathematical safeguard to keep A.I. under human control. They fear they are running out of time.
author: Eli Saslow and Erin Schaff

title: G.T.A. VI Is a Monumental Human Achievement
description: Anthropic goes public, Jensen Huang wants back in at Nvidia, and software patches seem to be breaking everything. But first, let’s talk about G.T.A.
author: Max Read, Erin Griffith, Whitney Jones, Sawyer Roque, Vjeran Pavic, Katie McMurran, Dan Powell, Marion Lozano, Rowan Niemisto and Elisheba Ittoop

title: How Jensen Huang Made Humiliation Routine at Nvidia
description: The Nvidia co-founder’s belittling behavior toward employees goes back decades. It once led to a confidential settlement agreement with an executive who said Mr. Huang “terrorized” staff.
author: Emily Steel, Kalley Huang, Ryan Mac and Tripp Mickle

title: A New Era of A.I.-Driven Chaos? That Might Just Be Progress.
description: If artificial intelligence is giving rise to outages, cyberattacks and more, it’s consistent with history, in that it shows how new innovations often set off calamitous failure before they make life better.
author: William J. Broad

title: Alice Huang, Accused of Spying on Nvidia’s CEO, Is Linked to Firms With Ties to China’s Military
description: Companies linked to Alice Huang, the woman at the heart of the Nvidia scandal, are part of a network of Chinese tech firms and defense contractors that need advanced computing power.
author: Julian E. Barnes, Paul Mozur and Ana Swanson
